transcript: Why wasn't the 30 Rock reunion filmed? Now obviously I wasn't privy to the behind the scenes conversations, but I do have some theories. The first is that NBC was seemingly not super involved in this event. Obviously they had to be involved in order for them to licence the logo and clips from the show, but seemingly that is where NBC's involvement ended. And that is notable considering that NBC And Peacock are really the only companies that could have streamed this, just given how much of their IP Is included in the event. So theory number one is that NBC Just said we don't want it, which I think would be a massive fumble, but television executives make bad decisions all the time so I wouldn't exactly be surprised. My second theory is that because this was an event for charity, a lot of the people involved were probably either donating their time or taking a very reduced fee. And I imagine that gets a lot more complicated the second you put a streaming component on top of that. Especially if it's being streamed for commercial use, which would include being streamed on NBC With ads or being streamed on Peacock behind a paywall. The second it becomes a commercial endeavor, all of these people need to be paid their regular rates and your costs go up astronomically. And while you could maybe find a way to Stream it non commercially. The additional cost and logistics of streaming just may not have been something they were able to handle. Especially without the backing of a large company like NBC. And then the third potential reason is that this was being put on with very limited rehearsal time. And while the event did end up running very smoothly. They obviously did not know that when they were planning it. And I imagine it was much easier for people to say yes, Knowing that if they flub a line or mess up in any way. It's only going to be in that room. And it's not gonna live online forever. And while I obviously don't wanna speculate on anyone's health, I will say that it's been 20 years, Some of the actors are getting up there in age. One of the actors was in a really serious car accident, That they are still dealing with the effects of today. And the scrutiny that comes with streaming is just so much greater than the scrutiny you get in a live venue. Whatever the actual reason, I could tell you it was not to spite their fans. They don't hate poor people. There are a lot of legitimate reasons why they would wanna keep this to a strictly live event.
